parsed.reason: Facts are all correct: rice was checked off and miso is the only item left on 買い物, with no invented items, no secret leaked, and the language is right. But the phrasing is stiff and log-like ("チェックを入れました", "残っているのは...だけです"), more of a status readout than a friend texting back, and it lacks any warmth like a thanks to Ken. It's polite です/ます register, which is acceptable for a group but not especially natural.
